description: Steps that are complete, current, upcoming or in error, horizontal or vertical, as a read-only progress strip (an order) or the buttons of a multi-step form, linear or not. The line between steps draws itself up to the current one, a finished step's number gives way to a check that draws itself, and panels arrive from the side you moved toward.
moves: The connector to the next step fills from its start once that step is reached, and empties when you go back.
A finished step's number shrinks into a blur and a check draws itself in its place.
The current step's indicator grows a touch and takes its ring.
A step's panel arrives 32px from the side you moved toward, with 6px of blur, on a spring (from below or above when vertical).
A step you can go to sinks a little when pressed.
keyboard: Moves into the steps as one tab stop, on the current step.
Moves between steps (ArrowDown and ArrowUp when vertical).
Moves to the first or last step.
Goes to the focused step, if it can be reached.

propDocs.Stepper.steps: The steps, in order: `{ value, label, description?, error?, disabled? }`.
propDocs.Stepper.defaultValue: The current step at first, when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first.
propDocs.Stepper.onValueChange: Runs with the next step. `details.reason` is "item-press", "next-press", "previous-press" or "imperative"; `details.cancel()` stays, like a step that doesn't validate.
propDocs.Stepper.completed: The steps that are done. Defaults to every step before the furthest one reached. Pass every value for a finished flow.
propDocs.Stepper.interactive: Steps are buttons (the default). Off, it is a read-only progress strip with `aria-current="step"` on the current one.
propDocs.Stepper.linear: Forward only through `next`, back to any step reached (the default). Off, any step can be chosen.
propDocs.Stepper.speed: How fast it moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
propDocs.StepperList.children: Optional: a function of `{ steps }` to lay the steps out yourself with `StepperItem`, `StepperStep`, `StepperIndicator`, `StepperTitle`, `StepperDescription` and `StepperConnector`.
propDocs.StepperPanel.value: The step whose content this is. Shown while that step is current.

cssVars: Finished and current steps, and the filled line
The line before it fills, and upcoming steps' rim
